purpose: Performance baseline of the current site, recorded before any retrieval or ranking work, so later change can be shown to help or hurt.
measured_at_note: Real wall-clock time of the measurement session, not a rounded placeholder.
method: See reports/baseline-method.md for exact reproduction steps.

environment.node_note: System node is v18.19.1, which cannot build this project: Vite 8 requires Node >=20.19 or >=22.12. CI uses Node 22, so v22.23.1 was used to match.

build.full_build_includes: npm run data + tsc -b + vite build

artifact_sizes_bytes.js_bundle_note: Single chunk. Exceeds Vite's 500 kB warning threshold; no code splitting configured.

largest_image.note: Effectively incompressible. Accounts for ~85% of the landing page's transfer. Filename contains a non-ASCII character.

category_files.note: Lazy-loaded per category by site/src/lib/data.ts, so a visitor pays for at most the categories they open.

deployed_transfer.encoding_finding: GitHub Pages serves gzip only. A client advertising only 'br' or only 'zstd' receives the full 6,908,069 bytes uncompressed with no Content-Encoding header. Real browsers advertise gzip so they get the compressed form.
deployed_transfer.cache_finding: Data files carry a 10-minute max-age and are not content-hashed, so returning visitors re-download index.json frequently. JS/CSS assets are content-hashed and cache well.

parse_and_heap.harness: Node 22 / V8, same engine family as Chrome. scratchpad/measure.mjs
parse_and_heap.note: Parse cost is on the full 6.9 MB regardless of transfer compression. This is the part that cannot be compressed away.

page_load_local_production_build.server: scratchpad/serve.mjs — gzip only, SPA fallback, max-age=600, mirroring measured GitHub Pages behaviour

landing.lcp_finding: LCP is driven by Qualität.png (1,490,614 bytes), which is ~85% of the page's transfer.

page_load_deployed.note: Run 1 reflects a cold CDN edge; runs 2-3 reflect a warm edge. Report the range, not the best case.

search_latency.haystack_finding: Building the haystack strings is 5.79 of the 6.97 ms filter cost — about 83%. haystack() is called inside the filter predicate (Library.tsx:76), so up to 10,000 array joins and toLowerCase() calls are redone on every keystroke. Nothing is precomputed or memoised per record.
search_latency.facet_finding: Facet-only filtering is roughly 11x cheaper than text search, which is consistent with the haystack cost dominating.

keystroke_to_paint_browser_ms.harness: scratchpad/cdp-search.mjs — native value setter + input event, waits two animation frames
keystroke_to_paint_browser_ms.finding: Full keystroke cost is ~50 ms, about 7x the filter-only cost, so React re-render of the 48 visible cards dominates. Queries returning nothing are faster (~32 ms) because no cards render. There is no debounce on the input.

retrieval_correctness_findings.note: Discovered while building the fixed query set. These are correctness defects, not performance, and they were not previously recorded. They matter because they define the R0 baseline that ENG-006 must beat.

multi_word_queries_return_nothing.cause: Search is a single substring test over one joined string (Library.tsx:76). A multi-word query only matches if those words appear adjacently, in that order, in the concatenation. Term-wise matching does not exist.
multi_word_queries_return_nothing.severity: high — a natural two-word query silently returns an empty result set

german_queries_return_nothing.cause: The corpus is ~91% English while the UI is German. Lexical substring matching cannot bridge that.
german_queries_return_nothing.severity: medium — verified as a real failure mode, and the strongest concrete argument for the embeddings ablation arm R7

google_fonts_third_party_request.detail: Both pages request fonts.googleapis.com at runtime (22,494 bytes decoded, 32-104 ms). This sends every visitor's IP address to Google.
google_fonts_third_party_request.relevance: The site ships Impressum and Datenschutz pages, so this is a GDPR consideration rather than a performance one. Not in scope for ENG-002; recorded because it was observed.

public_data_gitignore_RETRACTED.detail: An earlier draft of this report claimed site/public/data/ was not gitignored. That was WRONG and is retracted. The root .gitignore covers it explicitly at line 10 with the comment '# Generated site data (rebuilt from data/*.jsonl by `npm run data`)'. Verified with `git check-ignore -v`. The error came from reading only site/.gitignore and not the root one.
public_data_gitignore_RETRACTED.kept_because: Recording the retraction rather than deleting it, so the claim is not silently reintroduced from an earlier read of this file.

vite_preview_ignores_build_base.detail: vite.config.ts sets base only when command === 'build', so `vite preview` serves at / while the built assets reference /Prompt_Academy/. Preview of a production build therefore 404s its own assets.
vite_preview_ignores_build_base.severity: low — affects local verification, not production

system_node_too_old_to_build.detail: System node is v18.19.1; Vite 8 requires >=20.19 or >=22.12. There is no .nvmrc or engines field pinning the version, so a fresh checkout on this machine fails to build with a version error.
system_node_too_old_to_build.severity: low, but a guaranteed stumble for a new contributor

reproduction_check.note: The harness was re-run from the committed scripts/baseline/ paths as an independent second measurement, to confirm the numbers are reproducible and to record real run-to-run variance rather than presenting single values as exact.
reproduction_check.conclusion: Reproducible. Search-path timings vary by roughly 10-15% between sessions on an otherwise idle machine, so any claimed improvement below ~15% is not distinguishable from noise with this method and this n. Comparisons for ENG-006/ENG-007 must either exceed that margin or raise the repeat count.

budgets_proposed_for_eng_007.note: Derived from the measurements above. Proposed, not yet agreed; ENG-007 must not regress these.

not_measured.real_device_and_network: All numbers are from one machine on a wired connection with a headless browser. Mobile CPU and slow networks are UNMEASURED and would be substantially worse, particularly for the 6.9 MB parse.
not_measured.brotli_benefit: GitHub Pages does not offer brotli, so the potential saving is UNMEASURED and unavailable without changing host.
not_measured.cold_cdn_variance: Only one genuinely cold-edge deployed run was captured (run 1). The cold-start distribution is UNMEASURED.
not_measured.search_quality: Precision and recall against a labelled query set are UNMEASURED by design — that is ENG-005/ENG-006.
not_measured.repeat_visit_behaviour: Effect of the 600 s max-age on returning visitors is UNMEASURED.
